The input did not match the regular expression /CURRENT_TREE_V2/. Input:

'PROMETEO · UNIVERSAL SESSION PREFLIGHT V1\n' +
  'Status: BINDING CONTINUITY GUARD\n' +
  'Fast path: FAST_REINCARNATION_PATH_V1\n' +
  '\n' +
  'THIS DOES NOT CREATE A NEW AUTHORITY.\n' +
  'Current Tree, Organism, Work Context, Chat Object, source owners, Design DNA and worker packets keep their existing roles.\n' +
  '\n' +
  'CORE LAW\n' +
  'FIRST DURABLE ACTION = CREATE SUCCESSOR SESSION.\n' +
  'READ POINTERS, NOT THE WORLD.\n' +
  'EXPAND ONLY WHEN THE TASK DEMANDS IT.\n' +
  '\n' +
  '============================================================\n' +
  'A · FAST REINCARNATION · INTERACTIVE CONTINUATION\n' +
  '============================================================\n' +
  '\n' +
  'Use this path when CONTINUE already names a Chat Object and predecessor.\n' +
  '\n' +
  'R0 · Parse envelope\n' +
  'Extract chat_object_id, predecessor id/pin, focus if present, predecessor SESSION/JOURNAL refs, preflight/Current Tree ref and predecessor next_action.\n' +
  '\n' +
  'R1 · Minimal durable reads\n' +
  'Normal target: about 3–6 reads.\n' +
  '1. this preflight;\n' +
  '2. predecessor SESSION.json;\n' +
  '3. predecessor JOURNAL material head/latest entries needed;\n' +
  '4. named Current Tree or continuity snapshot;\n' +
  '5. one exact plan/source-owner ref already named by SESSION only when needed.\n' +
  '\n' +
  'Before READY:\n' +
  '- no broad repository search;\n' +
  '- no general web search;\n' +
  '- no repository clone;\n' +
  '- no Supabase/RPC investigation unless predecessor next_action explicitly requires repairing that source.\n' +
  '\n' +
  'R2 · Fresh identity\n' +
  'Create NEW session_id + session_pin. Never reuse predecessor identity.\n' +
  '\n' +
  'R3 · Successor publication\n' +
  'Before target-specific archaeology or implementation, publish successor durably.\n' +
  'Preferred one CAS/tree commit:\n' +
  '- successor SESSION.json;\n' +
  '- successor JOURNAL.json;\n' +
  '- successor CONTINUE.txt;\n' +
  '- INDEX.json update;\n' +
  '- predecessor successor_session_id/status update when practical.\n' +
  '\n' +
  'If one atomic write is unavailable, use the minimum sequential CAS writes. Do not insert research between them.\n' +
  '\n' +
  'R4 · Session Head / bootstrap receipt\n' +
  'Persist enough sanitized pointers for the next shell:\n' +
  '- predecessor_session_id / predecessor_head;\n' +
  '- repo_head_seen;\n' +
  '- current_tree_ref / organism_ref;\n' +
  '- objective_ref / current_plan_ref;\n' +
  '- work_context_refs;\n' +
  '- source_owner_refs;\n' +
  '- preservation_refs when applicable;\n' +
  '- focus_objects / active_project / organism_nodes;\n' +
  '- known_boundaries / known_degraded_sources;\n' +
  '- latest_material_entry;\n' +
  '- next_action;\n' +
  '- request_class;\n' +
  '- bootstrap_status.\n' +
  '\n' +
  'Set bootstrap_status=READY once identity, lineage, reopening pointers and exact next_action are durable.\n' +
  'READY does not claim every live dependency is healthy.\n' +
  '\n' +
  'R5 · Target-specific expansion\n' +
  'Only after READY:\n' +
  '- resolve the relevant Organism subgraph, not the whole organism;\n' +
  '- read exact target owner/parents/dependencies/related surfaces;\n' +
  '- read objective/plan/baseline;\n' +
  '- read Design DNA/Goldens only if the requested change touches their scope;\n' +
  '- inspect runtime/bytes/tests required by exact next_action;\n' +
  '- implement.\n' +
  '\n' +
  'R6 · Normal journal loop\n' +
  'For each material human interaction, update one sanitized journal entry before the final reply.\n' +
  '\n' +
  '============================================================\n' +
  'B · DEGRADED OWNER FAST FAIL\n' +
  '============================================================\n' +
  '\n' +
  'Live owner works -> use it.\n' +
  'Live owner fails/5xx/times out -> record DEGRADED -> use last-good/cache/GitHub durable owner -> continue when identity/lineage/pointers are sufficient.\n' +
  '\n' +
  'Do not turn a failed Current Tree/Organism/Work Context/Supabase read into storage archaeology unless the exact next_action is to repair it.\n' +
  '\n' +
  '============================================================\n' +
  'C · REQUEST CLASSIFICATION\n' +
  '============================================================\n' +
  '\n' +
  'CONTINUE: advances current plan.\n' +
  'COMPATIBLE_DELTA: improves/adds while preserving objective/baseline.\n' +
  'EXPERIMENT: explores an alternative without replacing CURRENT.\n' +
  'REPLAN: changes objective/order/strategy; preserve what is superseded and why.\n' +
  'DESTRUCTIVE_RESET: removes/rebuilds known-good behavior; obey human intent while preserving rollback/history where technically reasonable.\n' +
  '\n' +
  'Human intent is the new intent. Durable history prevents amnesia; it does not veto change.\n' +
  '\n' +
  '============================================================\n' +
  'D · ORGANISM TARGET RULE\n' +
  '============================================================\n' +
  '\n' +
  'Resolve only the relevant subgraph:\n' +
  'target node, owner, parents, dependencies, related surfaces/capabilities, status and known plan/baseline.\n' +
  '\n' +
  'Do not traverse the full Organism unless the task is genuinely global.\n' +
  'Organism informs execution; it never grants mutation authority.\n' +
  '\n' +
  '============================================================\n' +
  'E · NEW / ADOPTED INTERACTIVE CHAT\n' +
  '============================================================\n' +
  '\n' +
  'NEW CHAT:\n' +
  '- read this preflight + supplied focus/Current Tree pointer;\n' +
  '- create fresh session identity durably before broad discovery;\n' +
  '- reuse an existing Chat Object/Work Context when pointers show one;\n' +
  '- then expand target-specific context.\n' +
  '\n' +
  'ADOPT EXISTING CHAT:\n' +
  '- create a fresh durable session first from supplied focus/visible conversation identity;\n' +
  '- then backfill only material milestones supported by visible conversation or durable refs;\n' +
  '- record predecessor only when real evidence names it.\n' +
  '\n' +
  'Never publish raw private prompts, private note bodies, credentials, headers or hidden reasoning in the public journal.\n' +
  '\n' +
  '============================================================\n' +
  'F · WORKER VARIANT · DISPATCH FIRST\n' +
  '============================================================\n' +
  '\n' +
  'Workers use the same continuity principles but not the interactive startup order.\n' +
  '\n' +
  'Worker order:\n' +
  '1. create fresh worker identity/beacon required by CURRENT worker prompt;\n' +
  '2. dispatch/claim through CURRENT;\n' +
  '3. if WORK is returned, obey packet authority/scope;\n' +
  '4. before material mutation, read this preflight and only target-specific Current Tree/Organism/objective/baseline context;\n' +
  '5. read Design DNA only when owned work touches material architecture/global behavior;\n' +
  '6. execute and return evidence through existing worker protocol.\n' +
  '\n' +
  'A worker must not:\n' +
  '- create an interactive Chat Session as prerequisite to claim;\n' +
  '- traverse all Prometeo before claim;\n' +
  '- choose project/task/priority from Organism;\n' +
  '- use context to expand allowed_paths, tool_policy, authority or done_when.\n' +
  '\n' +
  '============================================================\n' +
  'G · SUCCESS BUDGET\n' +
  '============================================================\n' +
  '\n' +
  'Normal continuation target:\n' +
  '- 1 continuation envelope;\n' +
  '- ~3–6 durable reads;\n' +
  '- 1 successor publication CAS;\n' +
  '- bootstrap_status=READY;\n' +
  '- then target-specific work.\n' +
  '\n' +
  'Fast-path canary verifies fresh identity, correct lineage, durable bootstrap refs, preserved next_action, no human recap, no broad search/clone/Supabase before READY, no invented owner and no private raw prompt publication.\n'
